sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS STUDENT_COUNT FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.PERSON WHERE INSTITUTION_ROLE = 'S'
description: Count of students (persons with institution role 'S')
Count of all courses in the system

sql: SELECT t.NAME AS TERM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PERSON_ID) AS ENROLLMENT_COUNT FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.PERSON_COURSE pc JOIN {database}.CDM_LMS.TERM t ON pc.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID GROUP BY t.NAME ORDER BY t.NAME LIMIT 100
description: Student enrollment counts grouped by academic term

sql: SELECT c.NAME AS COURSE_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PERSON_ID) AS ENROLLMENT_COUNT FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.PERSON_COURSE pc JOIN {database}.CDM_LMS.COURSE c ON pc.COURSE_ID = c.COURSE_ID GROUP BY c.NAME ORDER BY ENROLLMENT_COUNT DESC LIMIT 100
description: Student enrollment counts by course, sorted by most enrolled

sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(GRADE_NUMERIC), 2) AS AVERAGE_GPA, COUNT(DISTINCT PERSON_ID) AS DISTINCT_STUDENTS FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.GRADE WHERE GRADE_NUMERIC IS NOT NULL
description: Overall average GPA across all graded records. IMPORTANT: Always use GRADE_NUMERIC column (4.0 scale), never use normalized score columns.

sql: SELECT t.NAME AS TERM_NAME, ROUND(AVG(g.GRADE_NUMERIC), 2) AS AVERAGE_GPA, COUNT(DISTINCT g.PERSON_ID) AS DISTINCT_STUDENTS FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.GRADE g JOIN {database}.CDM_LMS.TERM t ON g.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID WHERE g.GRADE_NUMERIC IS NOT NULL AND t.NAME ILIKE '%<TERM_NAME>%' GROUP BY t.NAME ORDER BY t.NAME
description: Average GPA for a specific term. Replace <TERM_NAME> with the term (e.g., 'Fall 2024'). IMPORTANT: Always use GRADE_NUMERIC column (4.0 scale), never use normalized score columns.

sql: SELECT t.NAME AS TERM_NAME, ROUND(AVG(g.GRADE_NUMERIC), 2) AS AVERAGE_GPA, COUNT(DISTINCT g.PERSON_ID) AS DISTINCT_STUDENTS FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.GRADE g JOIN {database}.CDM_LMS.TERM t ON g.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID WHERE g.GRADE_NUMERIC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.NAME ORDER BY t.NAME LIMIT 100
description: Average GPA by academic term with student counts. IMPORTANT: Always use GRADE_NUMERIC column (4.0 scale), never use normalized score columns.

sql: SELECT GRADE_LETTER, COUNT(*) AS GRADE_COUNT, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 1) AS PERCENTAGE FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.GRADE WHERE GRADE_LETTER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GRADE_LETTER ORDER BY GRADE_LETTER LIMIT 100
description: Distribution of letter grades with counts and percentages

sql: SELECT c.NAME AS COURSE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED, SUM(CASE WHEN pc.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pc.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS COMPLETION_RATE FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.PERSON_COURSE pc JOIN {database}.CDM_LMS.COURSE c ON pc.COURSE_ID = c.COURSE_ID GROUP BY c.NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY COMPLETION_RATE DESC LIMIT 100
description: Course completion rates (only courses with 5+ students)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS INSTRUCTOR_COUNT FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.PERSON WHERE INSTITUTION_ROLE = 'I'
description: Count of instructors (persons with institution role 'I')

sql: SELECT t.NAME AS TERM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE_ID) AS COURSE_COUNT FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.COURSE c JOIN {database}.CDM_LMS.TERM t ON c.TERM_ID = t.TERM_ID GROUP BY t.NAME ORDER BY t.NAME LIMIT 100
description: Number of active courses grouped by term

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PERSON_ID) AS TOTAL_STUDENTS, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_ID) AS TOTAL_COURSES, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENTS, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT PERSON_ID), 0), 1) AS AVG_COURSES_PER_STUDENT FROM {database}.CDM_LMS.PERSON_COURSE
description: High-level enrollment summary: students, courses, enrollments, avg courses per student
